map.常见肠道寄生虫虫卵形态学特征查询，辅助镜检识别: Query morphologic features of common intestinal parasite eggs to aid microscopy identification.
map.📖 查看「寄生虫虫卵形态识别器 使用指南」: View "Parasite Egg Morphology Identifier User Guide"
map.对粪便常见寄生虫虫卵形态要点做结构化对照，辅助镜检识别复习；确诊由寄生虫室判读。: Structured comparison of common fecal parasite-egg features to aid microscopy review; confirmation is by the parasitology lab.
map.虫卵鉴定依据：大小(μm)、形状、颜色、卵壳特征(厚薄/纹理)、卵盖有无、内容物: Egg identification uses size (μm), shape, color, shell features (thickness/texture), operculum presence and contents (ovum/miracidium/oncosphere). Measure size with a micrometer and avoid confusion with pollen or plant fibers.
map.教学演示虫卵形态差异与易混淆点。: Teach egg-form differences and confusing points.
map.钩虫卵较小、椭圆形、壳薄含数个卵胞；蛔虫卵较大、壳厚有凹凸蛋白膜；工具并列要点避: Hookworm eggs are smaller, oval, thin-shelled with several blastomeres; Ascaris eggs are larger, thick-shelled with a bumpy protein coat; the tool lists points side by side to avoid confusion.
map.能看到虫卵就确诊感染吗？: Does seeing an egg confirm infection?
map.通常是重要证据，但需排除污染与形态误判；阴性也不能完全排除（受排虫节律影响）。: It is usually important evidence, but exclude contamination and misidentification; a negative result also cannot fully rule out (oviposition rhythm varies).
map.自己能据此吃药吗？: Can medication be taken based on this?
map.不能，驱虫药选择由医师结合虫种与肝肾功能决定。: No, anthelmintic choice is decided by the physician based on species and liver/kidney function.
map.疑难用免疫学或分子方法确认，镜检为主筛。: For difficult cases use immunologic or molecular confirmation; microscopy is the primary screen.
